purpose: Evaluate broad exact-bill named-member Minnesota House committee roll calls as a zero-weight component of the single quick-evidence-v1 program before any broad historical result is observed.

source.sourcePolicy: exact official committee-minute pages enumerated without using floor outcomes
source.memberVotePolicy: named AYE/NAY only; voice votes and motion-result text without member names excluded

asOfPolicy.meetingTiming: committee meeting date must be strictly before the target floor-vote date
asOfPolicy.reason: historical committee and floor records are date-granular and do not prove ordering within a day

features.transform: log1p count per member/event before target vote
features.multiLabelPolicy: one recorded vote may contribute to more than one mechanics pair when the frozen taxonomy assigns multiple mechanics

coverageGate.failureAction: stop after coverage artifact; do not fit or score a predictive candidate

fit.model: multivariable ridge logistic offset on serving Quick logit
selectionMetricOrder: validation chamber mean absolute yes-vote error
